q.description: The search query text. This is case-insensitive.

elementType.description: The type of Postman resource to search for.

ownership.description:
The ownership scope for search results. One of:
- `organization` (default) — Resources owned by the user's team.
- `external` — Resources not owned by the user's team.
- `all` — All resources regardless of ownership.

filters.description: The search filters to narrow results.

SearchPostmanResourcesElementType.description: The type of Postman resource to search for.
SearchPostmanResourcesElementType.title: SearchPostmanResourcesElementType

SearchPostmanResourcesFilters.description: The search filters to narrow results.
SearchPostmanResourcesFilters.title: SearchPostmanResourcesFilters

SearchPostmanResourcesOwnership.description:
The ownership scope for search results. One of:
- `organization` (default) — Resources owned by the user's team.
- `external` — Resources not owned by the user's team.
- `all` — All resources regardless of ownership.
SearchPostmanResourcesOwnership.title: SearchPostmanResourcesOwnership

searchFilterAndOperation.description: A list of filter conditions that must all be true. Each item must contain exactly one filter.
searchFilterAndOperation.title: searchFilterAndOperation

$in.description: A list of collection IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of collection IDs to exclude.

searchFilterCollectionId.description: Filters by collection ID. Supported for `requests` and `collections` only.
searchFilterCollectionId.title: searchFilterCollectionId

$in.description: A list of creator IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of creator IDs to exclude.

searchFilterCreatedBy.description: Filters by the resource creator's user ID. Supported for all element types.
searchFilterCreatedBy.title: searchFilterCreatedBy

$in.description: A list of environment IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of environment IDs to exclude.

searchFilterEnvironmentId.description: Filters by environment ID. Supported for `environments` only.
searchFilterEnvironmentId.title: searchFilterEnvironmentId

$in.description: A list of flow IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of flow IDs to exclude.

searchFilterFlowId.description: Filters by flow ID. Supported for `flows` only.
searchFilterFlowId.title: searchFilterFlowId

$eq.description: If true, return only resources connected to Git.

$ne.description: If true, exclude resources connected to Git.

searchFilterGitConnected.description: Filters by Git connection status. Supported for `workspaces`, `collections`, `requests`, `environments`, `specs`, and `flows`.
searchFilterGitConnected.title: searchFilterGitConnected

$in.description: A list of organization IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of organization IDs to exclude.

searchFilterOrgId.description: Filters by organization ID. Supported for all element types.
searchFilterOrgId.title: searchFilterOrgId

$eq.description: If true, return only resources that are part of the Private API Network.

$ne.description: If true, exclude resources that are part of the Private API Network.

searchFilterPrivateApiNetwork.description: Filters by private API network membership. Supported for all element types.
searchFilterPrivateApiNetwork.title: searchFilterPrivateApiNetwork

$eq.description: If true, return only results from verified publishers.

$ne.description: If true, exclude results from verified publishers.

searchFilterPublisherIsVerified.description: Filters by publisher verification status. Supported for all element types.
searchFilterPublisherIsVerified.title: searchFilterPublisherIsVerified

$in.description: A list of HTTP methods to match.

$nin.description: A list of HTTP methods to exclude.

searchFilterRequestHttpMethod.description: Filters by HTTP method (for example, `GET` or `POST`). Supported for `requests` only.
searchFilterRequestHttpMethod.title: searchFilterRequestHttpMethod

$in.description: A list of request IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of request IDs to exclude.

searchFilterRequestId.description: Filters by request ID. Supported for `requests` only.
searchFilterRequestId.title: searchFilterRequestId

$in.description: A list of resource types to match.

$nin.description: A list of resource types to exclude.

searchFilterRequestResourceType.description: Filters by resource type variant (for example, `http` or `grpc`). Supported for `requests` only.
searchFilterRequestResourceType.title: searchFilterRequestResourceType

$in.description: A list of specification IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of specification IDs to exclude.

searchFilterSpecId.description: Filters by specification ID. Supported for `specs` only.
searchFilterSpecId.title: searchFilterSpecId

$in.description: A list of tags to match.

$nin.description: A list of tags to exclude.

searchFilterTags.description: Filters by tags. Supported for `workspaces` and `collections`.
searchFilterTags.title: searchFilterTags

$in.description: A list of team IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of team IDs to exclude.

searchFilterTeamId.description: Filters by team ID. Supported for all element types.
searchFilterTeamId.title: searchFilterTeamId

searchFilterVisibility.description:
Filters by workspace visibility. Supported for all element types. One of:
- `internal` — Only visible to the organization's team members.
- `public` — Visible to all Postman users.
- `partner` — Visible to assigned external partner users.
searchFilterVisibility.title: searchFilterVisibility

$in.description: A list of workspace IDs to match.

$nin.description: A list of workspace IDs to exclude.

searchFilterWorkspaceId.description: Filters by workspace ID. Supported for all element types.
searchFilterWorkspaceId.title: searchFilterWorkspaceId
